prompts.text: What do you spend time on outside of class, and what do you actually do there each week?
Tell me about something you made, fixed, organized or achieved that you are proud of. What was your part?
Describe a time something went wrong or was hard for you. What happened, and what did you do next?
What do you care about enough to give up free time for? Give a specific example.
What do you want to study or do after high school, and what experiences led you there?
Is there anything about your family, community or responsibilities at home that shapes how you spend your time?
